* test: migrate from tape to node:test, borp, and c8

Replace the tape test runner with node:test (run through borp) and add
V8 coverage via c8.

- Convert all 56 test files from the tape API (assertions on the test
  context) to node:test, using the test context's t.assert.* (which count
  toward t.plan) and async functions for event/callback-driven streaming,
  memdb, and decoder-error tests. t.plan(n) is kept; t.end() and the tape
  imports are removed.
- Assertion mapping is behavior-preserving: t.equal/t.equals are strict
  (===) so they become t.assert.strictEqual, t.deepEqual becomes
  t.assert.deepStrictEqual, t.throws/t.doesNotThrow/t.ok/t.error map to
  their t.assert equivalents, and t.pass becomes t.assert.ok(true, msg).
- package.json: scripts.test is now "standard && borp"; add
  scripts.test:coverage ("standard && c8 borp"); drop tape and
  tap-mocha-reporter devDependencies; add borp and c8.
- Add .c8rc.json to scope coverage to index.js and lib/.
- Update AGENTS.md test guidance.

The converted node:test suite runs the same 2486 test cases and all pass
(tape reported 4391 because it counts each assertion as a TAP test line,
while node:test counts test-case blocks); coverage is ~95% lines.

* test: await subtests so parent tests are Node 22 compatible

node:test on Node 22 cancels subtests when the parent test callback
returns synchronously without awaiting them (Node 24+ no longer does).
Convert the 35 subtest-driving files so the parent test and its helper
functions are async and every t.test(...) is awaited, which keeps the
subtests alive on every supported Node version.

- Parents become 'async function (t)' and forEach loops that spawn
  subtests become 'for...of' loops so their t.test calls can be awaited
  (the original forEach callback closing paren was brace-matched away).
- The two files that route subtests through a local 'doTest' helper make
  that helper async and await it at the call sites.
- Subtest callbacks are also 'async'; harmless for the synchronous
  assertion bodies.

Verified: all 2486 tests pass on Node 22.23.3, 24.21.0, and 26.10.0 with
